name: Pull-up
steps: Hang from the bar, palms facing away, hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
Pull your chest up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Chin-up
steps: Hang from the bar, palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar, elbows close to your body.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Assisted Pull-up
steps: Pick the help weight; more weight makes it easier.
Kneel on the pad and grip the top handles, palms facing away.
Pull up until your chin clears the handles, then lower slowly.

name: Assisted Chin-up
steps: Pick the help weight; more weight makes it easier.
Kneel on the pad and grip the bar, palms facing you, shoulder-width.
Pull up until your chin clears your hands, then lower slowly.

name: Weighted Pull-up
steps: Hang a plate from a dip belt, or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Grip the bar palms away, hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower slowly to straight arms.

name: Weighted Chin-up
steps: Hang a plate from a dip belt, or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Grip the bar palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower slowly to straight arms.

name: Negative Pull-up
steps: Stand on a box and grip the bar, palms facing away.
Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly, over 3 to 5 seconds, until your arms are straight.
Step back onto the box and repeat.

name: Band-Assisted Pull-up
steps: Loop a band over the bar; a thicker band gives more help.
Put one knee or foot in the band and grip the bar, palms away.
Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower slowly.

name: Inverted Row
steps: Lie under a bar set at waist height and grip it, palms facing away.
Keep your body straight from head to heels, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up to the bar, then lower until your arms are straight.

name: Muscle-up
steps: Hang from the bar, palms facing away, hands about shoulder-width.
Pull hard and fast, bringing the bar toward your lower chest.
Lean your chest over the bar and push down until your arms are straight.
Lower yourself back to a hang with control.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-up
steps: Grip the parallel handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with straight arms, then pull up until your chin clears the handles.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-up
steps: Grip the bar palms away, hands well wider than your shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit with your thighs under the pads and grip the bar wide, palms away.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to your upper chest, not your neck.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Machine Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit with your thighs under the pads and grip both handles overhead.
Pull the handles down until your hands reach shoulder height.
Let them rise slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Clip a V-handle to the high cable and sit with thighs under the pads.
Hold the handle, palms facing each other, and lean back slightly.
Pull it to your upper chest, then let it rise slowly to straight arms.

name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit with thighs under the pads and grip the bar shoulder-width, palms facing you.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows close to your sides.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
steps: Clip a single handle to the high cable and sit or kneel facing it.
Pull the handle down to your shoulder, elbow close to your side.
Let it rise until your arm is straight; switch arms after your reps.

name: Kneeling Cable Pulldown
steps: Clip a bar or rope to the high cable and kneel facing it.
Hold it with straight arms, upper body tall and hips forward.
Pull it down to your upper chest, then let it rise slowly.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
steps: Stand facing the high cable and grip the bar, palms down.
Lean forward a little, arms straight with a soft bend at the elbows.
Sweep the bar down to your thighs, then let it rise to eye level.

name: Cable Pullover
steps: Clip a rope to the high cable, step back and lean forward a little.
Hold the rope up in front of your head with arms nearly straight.
Pull the rope down in an arc to your thighs, then return slowly.

name: Machine Pullover
steps: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot.
Sit back and hold the bar overhead, arms nearly straight.
Pull it down in an arc toward your belly, then return slowly.

name: Barbell Row
steps: Hold the bar palms down, hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
Push your hips back and lean forward, back flat, knees slightly bent.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, then lower it to straight arms.

name: Pendlay Row
steps: Bend over the bar on the floor until your back is nearly level.
Grip it a bit wider than your shoulders, palms down, back flat.
Pull it fast to your lower chest, then set it back down each rep.

name: Reverse-Grip Barbell Row
steps: Hold the bar with palms facing up, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lean forward partway with knees slightly bent and back flat.
Pull the bar to your belly button, elbows close, then lower it slowly.

name: T-Bar Row
steps: Stand over the bar, feet either side, and grip the handles.
Lean forward with knees slightly bent and back flat.
Pull the handles toward your chest, then lower until your arms are straight.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
steps: Lie face down on the angled pad with your feet on the platform.
Grip the handles with your arms hanging straight.
Pull the handles toward your chest, then lower them slowly.

name: Meadows Row
steps: Stand side-on to the end of a landmine bar, back flat.
Grip the end of the bar overhand, other forearm resting on your knee.
Pull the bar up toward your hip, then lower it slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
steps: Put one knee and one hand on a bench, back flat.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand with your arm hanging straight.
Pull it up toward your hip, elbow close, then lower it slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
steps: Hold two dumbbells with your palms turned toward your body.
Push your hips back and lean forward, back flat, knees slightly bent.
Pull both dumbbells to your lower ribs, then lower them to straight arms.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
steps: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest-down on it.
Let a dumbbell hang straight down from each hand.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your ribs, then lower them slowly.

name: Seated Cable Row
steps: Sit at the low cable with your feet on the plate, knees slightly bent.
Hold the V-handle with straight arms and sit tall.
Pull the handle to your belly, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let your arms straighten slowly without rounding your back.

name: Straight-Bar Cable Row
steps: Clip a straight bar to the low cable and sit with knees slightly bent.
Grip it palms down, hands about shoulder-width, and sit tall.
Pull the bar to your belly, then let your arms straighten slowly.

name: Wide-Grip Cable Row
linkNames: Seated Cable Row - Bar Wide Grip
steps: Clip a long bar to the low cable and sit with knees slightly bent.
Grip it palms down, hands well wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar to your lower chest, elbows out, then return slowly.

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
steps: Clip one handle to a low cable, then sit or stand facing it.
Pull the handle to your side, elbow close, without twisting your body.
Let your arm straighten slowly; switch arms after your reps.

name: Seated Machine Row
steps: Set the seat so the handles are level with your chest.
Sit with your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
Pull the handles back until your elbows pass your body, then return slowly.

name: Iso-Lateral Row
steps: Sit with your chest on the pad and feet flat.
Grip both handles; each side moves on its own.
Pull the handles toward your ribs, then let them go forward slowly.

name: Iso-Lateral High Row
steps: Sit with your thighs under the pad and reach up to the high handles.
Pull the handles down and back toward your chest.
Let them rise slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Iso-Lateral Low Row
steps: Sit with your chest on the pad and grip the low handles.
Pull the handles back toward your hips, elbows close.
Let them go forward slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Smith Machine Row
steps: Set the bar at knee height and grip it palms down, a bit wide.
Unhook it, push your hips back and lean forward, back flat.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, then lower it to straight arms.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
steps: Stand tall, holding a dumbbell at each side.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears, arms straight.
Hold for a second, then lower your shoulders slowly.

name: Barbell Shrug
steps: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs, hands just wider than shoulders.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Shrug
steps: Clip a straight bar to the low cable and hold it at your thighs.
Stand tall and lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly with straight arms.

name: Smith Machine Shrug
steps: Set the bar at mid-thigh height and grip it just wider than shoulders.
Unhook the bar and stand tall with straight arms.
Lift your shoulders toward your ears, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Trap Bar Shrug
steps: Stand inside the trap bar and lift it like a deadlift.
With arms straight, lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Machine Shrug
steps: Stand in the machine with the handles at your sides, arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Incline Y-Raise
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, a light dumbbell in each hand.
With thumbs up, raise your arms forward and out into a Y shape.
Lower them slowly until they hang straight down.

name: Deadlift
steps: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, feet hip-width.
Push your hips back and grip the bar just outside your legs, back flat.
Stand up tall by pushing the floor away, keeping the bar close.
Lower it the same way, hips back first, to the floor.

name: Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, the bar over your feet.
Squat down and grip the bar inside your knees, back flat, chest up.
Push your knees out and stand up, keeping the bar close.
Lower it the same way to the floor.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
steps: Stand in the middle of the trap bar, feet hip-width.
Bend your hips and knees to grip the handles, back flat, chest up.
Push through the floor and stand up tall.
Lower the bar the same way to the floor.

name: Rack Pull
steps: Set the bar on the rack pins or blocks just below your knees.
Grip it just outside your legs, hips back, back flat.
Stand up tall, pushing your hips forward.
Lower the bar back to the pins with control.

name: Smith Machine Deadlift
steps: Set the bar at its lowest height and stand close, feet hip-width.
Push your hips back and grip the bar just outside your legs, back flat.
Stand up tall, then lower the bar the same way, hips back first.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell hanging at each side.
Push your hips back and bend your knees, lowering the weights to your shins.
Keep your back flat and stand back up by pushing the floor away.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
steps: Stand holding the bar at your thighs, knees only slightly bent.
With your back flat, lower the bar down your legs to a deep stretch.
Push your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Good Morning
steps: Rest a barbell on your upper back, as for a squat.
With knees slightly bent and back flat, push your hips back and lean forward.
Stop when your upper body is nearly level, then stand back up.

name: Smith Machine Good Morning
steps: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and rest it on your upper back.
Unhook it, then push your hips back and lean forward, back flat.
Stop when your upper body is nearly level, then stand back up.

name: Back Extension
steps: Set the pad just below your hips and hook your ankles under the rollers.
Cross your arms on your chest and lower your upper body toward the floor.
Rise until your body is in a straight line, without leaning back.

name: Weighted Back Extension
steps: Set up on the back extension bench and hug a plate to your chest.
Lower your upper body toward the floor with your back flat.
Rise until your body is in a straight line, then repeat.

name: Machine Back Extension
steps: Sit with your upper back against the pad and feet on the footrest.
Cross your arms and push back until you are upright.
Return forward slowly with control.

name: Stability Ball Back Extension
steps: Lie face down with your hips on the ball and toes on the floor.
Put your hands by your ears and let your chest curl over the ball.
Lift your chest until your body is straight, then lower slowly.

name: Superman
steps: Lie face down with your arms stretched out past your head.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a little off the floor.
Hold for two seconds, then lower back down.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
steps: Lie on your stomach on a high bench, hips right at its end.
Hold the bench and let your legs hang toward the floor.
Lift your legs until they line up with your body, then lower slowly.
